title: Around-town use and long-term ownership references
summary: This topic mixes comments about around-town practicality and economy with unrelated mentions of years of ownership, local availability, and isolated service or lighting frustrations.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car as easy to use around town, fuel-efficient on short trips, and still comfortable or enjoyable compared with older BMWs.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on frustration with unresolved faults and brand disappointment rather than a consistent around-town driving issue.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly mention duration, location, or usage context such as ownership length, driving around town, or cars sitting unused without a clear evaluative stance.

limitations: The keyword cluster is semantically loose and combines around-town driving, time spans like years of ownership, and unrelated uses of the word 'around'.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so clear opinionated evidence is limited.
